answer: Answers are salted with a 182 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the inlet salt is published after the hollow checkpoint, the shale audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 52 keys hence pays for 52 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
